user.title: User
user.description: Represents a user in the system, who can be an Admin, Investor, or Client.

lastZakatPaymentDate.description: The timestamp of the user's last Zakat payment.

fcmTokens.description: Array of Firebase Cloud Messaging tokens for push notifications.

legalDocumentUrl.description: A Base64-encoded Data URI of the user's signed legal document.

referredByCode.description: The referral code of the marketer who referred this user.

deal.title: Deal
deal.description: Represents a financing deal for a client.

dealName.description: A descriptive name for the deal.

clientId.description: The ID of the client associated with this deal.

clientName.description: The name of the client (denormalized for display).

principal.description: The principal amount of the loan.

profitRate.description: The annual profit rate for the deal.

managementFeeRate.description: The percentage of the principal to be charged as a management fee.

managementFeePaid.description: Whether the management fee has been paid and approved.

durationValue.description: The numeric value for the duration of the deal.

durationUnit.description: The unit of time for the deal's duration.

status.description: The current status of the deal.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the deal record was created in the system.

startDate.description: The official start date of the financing term, used for amortization calculations. Defaults to createdAt if not provided.

marketerId.description: The ID of the marketer who sourced this deal.

dealRequest.title: Deal Request
dealRequest.description: Represents a deal requested by a client, pending admin approval.

dealName.description: A descriptive name for the deal.

clientId.description: The ID of the client requesting the deal.

durationValue.description: The proposed numeric value for the deal duration.

durationUnit.description: The unit for the deal's duration.

proposalDetails.description: The text summary of the client's deal proposal.

proposalPdf.description: A Base64-encoded Data URI of the uploaded proposal PDF.

processedAt.description: Timestamp when an admin processed the request.

depositRequest.title: Deposit Request
depositRequest.description: A request from an investor to deposit funds into their investible account.

investorId.description: The ID of the investor making the request.

status.description: The status of the deposit request.

processedAt.description: Timestamp when an admin processed the request.

fundBatch.title: Fund Batch
fundBatch.description: A specific batch of capital from an investor or the platform, available for investment.

sourceId.description: The ID of the source (Investor's user ID or 'platform').

amount.description: The amount of capital in this batch.

remainingAmount.description: The amount of capital from this batch that is still available to be invested.

tenureValue.description: The numeric value for the tenure of the investment.

tenureUnit.description: The unit of time for the investment's tenure.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the funds were added.

investment.title: Investment
investment.description: Links an investor to a deal and the amount they invested.

investorId.description: The ID of the investor user.

dealId.description: The ID of the deal being invested in.

transaction.title: Transaction
transaction.description: Logs every financial transaction within the platform.

dealId.description: The ID of the deal related to this transaction (if applicable).

userId.description: The ID of the user related to this transaction (if applicable).

repayment.title: Repayment
repayment.description: Represents a repayment made by a client for a deal.

dealId.description: The ID of the deal this repayment is for.

clientId.description: The ID of the client making the payment.

lodgedAt.description: The timestamp when the client lodged the payment.

approvedAt.description: The timestamp when the admin approved the payment.

dueDate.description: The original due date for this repayment from the schedule.

installmentNumber.description: The installment number from the amortization schedule.

withdrawalRequest.title: Withdrawal Request
withdrawalRequest.description: A request from an investor to withdraw funds from their account.

investorId.description: The ID of the investor making the request.

investorName.description: The name of the investor (denormalized for display).

status.description: The status of the withdrawal request.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the investor made the request.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when an admin processed the request.

reinvestmentRequest.title: Reinvestment Request
reinvestmentRequest.description: A request from an investor to reinvest their profits.

investorId.description: The ID of the investor making the request.

investorName.description: The name of the investor (denormalized for display).

amount.description: The amount of profit to reinvest.

status.description: The status of the reinvestment request.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the investor made the request.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when an admin processed the request.

terminationRequest.title: Termination Request
terminationRequest.description: A request from a client to terminate a deal early.

dealId.description: The ID of the deal being requested for termination.

clientId.description: The ID of the client making the request.

status.description: The status of the termination request.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the client made the request.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when an admin processed the request.

platformEarning.description: The profit earned by the platform upon termination.

administrativeTransaction.title: Administrative Transaction
administrativeTransaction.description: Logs financial activities related to the platform's operational account (e.g., expenses, admin deposits).

amount.description: The transaction amount. Positive for deposits/inflows, negative for expenses/outflows.

description.description: A brief description of the transaction (e.g., 'Office Supplies', 'Initial float').

dealId.description: The ID of the associated deal (if applicable).

dealName.description: The name of the associated deal (if applicable).

clientId.description: The ID of the associated client (if applicable).

clientName.description: The name of the associated client (if applicable).

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: Represents a physical or digital asset owned by the platform.

description.description: A description of the asset (e.g., 'MacBook Pro 16-inch').

acquisitionCost.description: The cost to acquire the asset. Can be 0 for existing assets.

acquisitionDate.description: When the asset was acquired or recognized.

status.description: The current status of the asset.

salePrice.description: The price the asset was sold for.

notification.title: Notification
notification.description: Represents a notification for an admin.

message.description: The main content of the notification.

link.description: A URL to the relevant page (e.g., an approval page).

read.description: Whether the notification has been read.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the notification was created.

platformSetting.title: Platform Setting
platformSetting.description: A global setting for the platform, like the Zakat Nisab or company logo.

nisab.description: The minimum wealth threshold for Zakat eligibility in Naira.

logoUrl.description: A base64 data URI of the company logo.

chatRequest.title: Chat Request
chatRequest.description: A request from a user to initiate a chat with an admin.

userId.description: The ID of the user requesting the chat.

participantIds.description: Array of user IDs participating in the chat.

participantNames.description: Denormalized names of participants for display.

lastMessage.description: A snippet of the most recent message for previews.

lastMessageSenderId.description: The ID of the user who sent the last message.

readBy.description: Array of user IDs who have read the last message.

message.title: Message
message.description: An individual message within a conversation.

conversationId.description: The ID of the parent conversation.

senderId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

text.description: The text content of the message.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the message was sent.

attachmentUrl.description: URL of an attachment (e.g., a PDF data URI).

attachmentName.description: The original name of the attached file.

taxRecord.title: Tax Record
taxRecord.description: A record of a tax calculation for a specific period.

periodStart.description: The start date of the calculation period.

periodEnd.description: The end date of the calculation period.

totalRevenue.description: The gross turnover used for the tax estimate.

expenses.description: Recorded business expenses for the period.

adjustedProfit.description: Profit after add-backs and exempt-income adjustments.

assessableProfit.description: Assessable profit used for Development Levy.

totalProfits.description: Taxable total profits used for Companies Income Tax (CIT).

developmentLevy.description: The calculated Development Levy under the 2026 Nigerian Tax Act.

minimumEtrTopUp.description: Estimated minimum effective tax top-up, where applicable.

whtCredits.description: Withholding tax credits applied against corporate tax due.

corporateTaxPayable.description: Estimated corporate tax payable after WHT credits.

inputVat.description: Input VAT recoverable from qualifying purchases.

profitAfterTax.description: The final profit after all taxes.

lawBasis.description: The law basis used for the estimate.

recoveryTask.title: Recovery Task
recoveryTask.description: A task assigned to the Recovery or Legal team for an upcoming or overdue payment.

lastLog.description: A snippet of the most recent log entry for quick view.

assigneeId.description: The ID of the team member this task is assigned to.

assigneeName.description: The name of the assigned team member.

log.title: Log Entry
log.description: A log entry or note for a recovery task.

text.description: The content of the log entry.

authorId.description: The ID of the user who created the log.

authorName.description: The name of the user who created the log.

/dealRequests/{dealRequestId}.description: Stores client requests for new deals, pending admin approval.

/depositRequests/{depositRequestId}.description: Stores investor requests to deposit funds.

/fundBatches/{fundBatchId}.description: A ledger of all investable capital batches.

/investments/{investmentId}.description: Tracks which investor has invested in which deal.

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: A log of all financial transactions.

/repayments/{repaymentId}.description: Tracks client repayments that are pending or completed.

/withdrawalRequests/{withdrawalRequestId.description: Tracks investor requests to withdraw funds.

/reinvestmentRequests/{reinvestmentReque.description: Tracks investor requests to reinvest their profits.

/terminationRequests/{terminationRequest.description: Tracks client requests to terminate a deal.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Stores admin notifications for pending actions.

/platformSettings/zakat.description: Stores global platform settings, specifically the Zakat configuration.

/platformSettings/branding.description: Stores global platform settings, specifically the company branding.

/platformSettings/bankDetails.description: Stores the platform's main bank account details for user deposits.

/chatRequests/{chatRequestId}.description: Stores user pings to an admin to start a chat.

/conversations/{conversationId}.description: Stores metadata for a single chat conversation.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Sub-collection for messages within a conversation.

/taxRecords/{taxRecordId}.description: Stores historical tax calculations for auditing.

/recoveryTasks/{taskId}.description: Stores automated tasks for the Recovery and Legal teams regarding upcoming or overdue payments.

/recoveryTasks/{taskId}/logs/{logId}.description: Stores log entries for a specific recovery task.
